name: 01950 · Newburyport, MA
findings: ZIP 01950 (Newburyport) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01950 (Newburyport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01950 (Newburyport) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
